title: Implement an approved screen as a coherent unit
description:
Problem/Goal: Implement the approved interface without redesign.
Authoritative references: ...
Source authority and precedence: task constraints, screen reference, imposed system, project patterns.
Fidelity mode: exact.
Design-system role: consumer.
Out of scope: token, shell, library, and copy changes.
Success criteria: specified states, viewports, and evidence conform to the sources.
objective: Deliver a faithful approved UI implementation.
result: A tested coherent screen/component with required fidelity evidence.
steps: Inspect required sources and map regions to primitives.
Implement states, responsive behavior, and local accessibility together.
Capture required evidence and verify protected paths.
acceptance_criteria: Only supplied design-system tokens and variants are used.
The required screenshot is captured at the specified viewport.
No read-only or forbidden path changes.
